narrative: On the board. The two plain lines have a single stroke through them. They are still readable. Nothing is written underneath. On the board. The plain lines are a smear. The leaf is nearly blank again. Ink on the right forefinger. The bundle unopened. On the board. In the margin, small, not as a speech. The centre of the leaf is empty.
